items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 November 2026 8:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 21 November 2026 at 8:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

High pressure east of Greenland, extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 this morning, 5 or 6 in the evening, then further increasing 6 or 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight or moderate this afternoon, then moderate or rough overnight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally poor in any mist.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or Southeast 6 or 7, decreasing 5 or 6 later tomorrow afternoon or evening, then 4 or 5 overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
